metrics.label: v0, local, not federated / not the official job

baselines.no_change+dP: no change plus the power change added to the served signal, interference held fixed: each cell's served RSRP and SINR shift by that cell's d_power; coverage (RSRP > -97 dBm) and SLA (SINR > 0 dB) follow from a normal fit to each cell's mean and p10, weighted by user share; sinr_p10_db and sinr_mean_db += share-weighted mean d_power
baselines.ridge: linear least squares on the same encoded inputs, trained on the train seeds, predicting the residual

metrics.labels_are: KPI deltas vs the no-op counterfactual at the same step
metrics.direction_definition: sign of the predicted delta vs the measured delta, rows with a nonzero change and |measured delta| > 0.004
